title: Prepare an extended read-only technical profile collector
acceptance: Commands only read technical metadata and do not invoke su/reboot/install/flash.
Vulkan hardware identifiers are removed before saving; device-tree properties use an allowlist.
Unavailable data is recorded as unavailable, not replaced by assumptions.
Tests cover sanitization, device-tree filtering and collection boundaries.
steps: Save actual device observations under DEV-001 separately from host tests.
